minutes.headline: TCP committee approved a plan to catch up missing minutes; members rejected building an addition for the boys and girls club
minutes.summary: The committee heard public comment on missing minutes and non-municipal uses, approved the prior minutes with edits, and approved a plan to divide up the backlog of unpublished minutes. The architects presented existing-conditions, code and environmental findings and two test-fit layouts for the building. Members spoke against an addition, debated the boys and girls club, a commercial kitchen and community outreach, and set the next meeting dates.

public_comment.stated_role: chairman of planning board and agricultural commission
public_comment.topic: Missing minutes on the website, whether a non-municipal use such as the Grange or a public market could be considered, and what the planning process is.

Personal views: the building should be municipal and community space, the schools do not need space there, the commercial kitchen should not be only for the cable group, the bond bill money has not been discussed, and the Grange needs only a few hours twice a month.

votes.motion: Approve the minutes of the last meeting with the discussed modifications
Approve the chair's plan for dividing up the work of preparing the past minutes

budget_items.what_was_said: A member asked for a sense of whether the project is heading toward a ten or fifteen million range. The architects said they would give ranges by component with caveats once scope items are identified.
A member cited a past kitchen renovation as an example of cost and said voters would not favor an expensive commercial kitchen.
A resident said a bond bill grant for a community kitchen and other uses has not been discussed.
A resident criticised the cost of the new middle high school.

decisions.decision: Members agreed to tell the architects they do not want new additional space beyond small areas such as bathrooms.
Next meetings set for August 31 and September 10, then September 21.
The chair will draft a community outreach notice for the August 31 meeting. Mr. Allison will be asked to reach out to the Grange and the agricultural groups.
The chair will check with the architects before the August 31 agenda on whether they need time.

what_happened.line: Members agreed to tell the architects they do not want new additional space beyond small areas such as bathrooms.
The committee voted on the chair's plan for dividing up the work of preparing the past minutes; the minutes record the vote as not audible.
The architects presented existing-conditions, code and environmental findings and two test-fit layouts for the building.
The chair will draft a community outreach notice, and Mr. Allison will be asked to contact the Grange and agricultural groups.
Next meetings were set for August 31 and September 10, then September 21.

why_it_matters: The building's size and use are being settled before any cost is set, and ruling out an addition limits what the project can hold and, in turn, what voters may later be asked to fund.
Architects have said they will give cost ranges by component only once scope items are identified, so a total price is not yet known.

Cost ranges by component from the architects once scope items are identified.
